question: Which of our strategic accounts are at risk because of late shipments, and what should the account teams do this week?

input.purpose: See which tier values exist for Salesforce accounts and how many active accounts each has.
input.sql: SELECT tier_c, COUNT(*) AS n, SUM(CASE WHEN _fivetran_active THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS active_n, SUM(CASE WHEN is_deleted THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS deleted_n FROM salesforce.account GROUP BY tier_c ORDER BY n DESC

input.purpose: Check shipment status values and sync freshness in the carrier database.
input.sql: SELECT status, COUNT(*) AS n, MAX(_fivetran_synced) AS last_synced, MAX(updated_at) AS last_updated, SUM(CASE WHEN _fivetran_deleted THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS deleted_n FROM carrier_pg.shipment GROUP BY status ORDER BY n DESC

input.purpose: Check event types and freshness in the shipment event table.
input.sql: SELECT event_type, COUNT(*) AS n, MAX(event_at) AS last_event, MAX(_fivetran_synced) AS last_synced FROM carrier_pg.shipment_event GROUP BY event_type ORDER BY n DESC

input.purpose: Test the join from carrier shipments to SAP deliveries and then to customers.
input.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS shipments, COUNT(DISTINCT s.delivery_number) AS deliveries, SUM(CASE WHEN l.vbeln IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS matched_likp, SUM(CASE WHEN l.zz_carrier_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS with_carrier FROM carrier_pg.shipment s LEFT JOIN sap_s4.likp l ON l.vbeln = s.delivery_number AND NOT l._fivetran_deleted WHERE NOT s._fivetran_deleted

input.purpose: Check how SAP customer numbers link to Salesforce accounts (KNA1 kunnr vs account sap_customer_number_c) and whether duplicates exist.
input.sql: SELECT a.name, a.tier_c, a.sap_customer_number_c, a._fivetran_active, k.kunnr, k.name_1, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY a.sap_customer_number_c) AS dup FROM salesforce.account a LEFT JOIN sap_s4.kna_1 k ON k.kunnr = a.sap_customer_number_c AND NOT k._fivetran_deleted WHERE a.tier_c = 'Strategic' ORDER BY a.name

input.purpose: Profile SAP delivery date fields (planned vs actual goods issue) to pick a promised-date and actual-date basis.
input.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n, SUM(CASE WHEN try_strptime(lfdat,'%Y%m%d') IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS no_lfdat, SUM(CASE WHEN try_strptime(wadat,'%Y%m%d') IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS no_wadat, SUM(CASE WHEN try_strptime(wadat_ist,'%Y%m%d') IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS no_wadat_ist, MIN(lfdat) AS min_lfdat, MAX(lfdat) AS max_lfdat, MIN(wadat_ist) AS min_ist, MAX(wadat_ist) AS max_ist, MAX(erdat) AS max_erdat, SUM(CASE WHEN wadat_ist > lfdat THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ist_after_lfdat FROM sap_s4.likp WHERE NOT _fivetran_deleted

input.purpose: Compare carrier delivered timestamp against the SAP planned delivery date for matched shipments to see how lateness behaves.
input.sql: WITH d AS (SELECT s.shipment_id, s.status, s.delivery_number, l.lfdat, l.wadat_ist, l.kunnr, (SELECT MAX(e.event_at) FROM carrier_pg.shipment_event e WHERE e.shipment_id = s.shipment_id AND e.event_type='delivered') AS delivered_at FROM carrier_pg.shipment s JOIN sap_s4.likp l ON l.vbeln = s.delivery_number AND NOT l._fivetran_deleted WHERE NOT s._fivetran_deleted AND s.status='delivered') SELECT COUNT(*) AS n, SUM(CASE WHEN delivered_at IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS no_event, SUM(CASE WHEN CAST(delivered_at AS DATE) > try_strptime(lfdat,'%Y%m%d')::DATE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS late_vs_lfdat, SUM(CASE WHEN try_strptime(wadat_ist,'%Y%m%d') IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS no_ist, MIN(CAST(delivered_at AS DATE) - try_strptime(lfdat,'%Y%m%d')::DATE) AS min_days, MAX(CAST(delivered_at AS DATE) - try_strptime(lfdat,'%Y%m%d')::DATE) AS max_days, AVG(CAST(delivered_at AS DATE) - try_strptime(lfdat,'%Y%m%d')::DATE) AS avg_days FROM d

input.purpose: Monthly late-delivery rate by planned date, to see the trend and choose a recent window.
input.sql: WITH d AS (SELECT s.status, l.lfdat, (SELECT MAX(e.event_at) FROM carrier_pg.shipment_event e WHERE e.shipment_id = s.shipment_id AND e.event_type='delivered') AS delivered_at FROM carrier_pg.shipment s JOIN sap_s4.likp l ON l.vbeln = s.delivery_number AND NOT l._fivetran_deleted WHERE NOT s._fivetran_deleted AND s.status<>'cancelled') SELECT substr(lfdat,1,6) AS ym, COUNT(*) AS n, SUM(CASE WHEN status='delivered' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS delivered, SUM(CASE WHEN status='delivered' AND CAST(delivered_at AS DATE) > try_strptime(lfdat,'%Y%m%d')::DATE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS late, SUM(CASE WHEN status<>'delivered' AND try_strptime(lfdat,'%Y%m%d') < DATE '2026-11-06' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS open_past_due FROM d WHERE lfdat >= '20260101' AND lfdat <= '20261120' GROUP BY ym ORDER BY ym

input.purpose: Check the Zendesk ticket volume and status values, and whether tickets link to organizations that map to accounts.
input.sql: SELECT status, type, COUNT(*) AS n, MAX(updated_at) AS last_upd FROM zendesk.ticket WHERE NOT _fivetran_deleted GROUP BY status, type ORDER BY n DESC

input.purpose: See how Zendesk organizations relate to SAP customer numbers or account names, and how many open shipping-related tickets exist.
input.sql: SELECT o.id, o.name, o.external_id, COUNT(t.id) AS tickets, SUM(CASE WHEN t.status IN ('new','open','pending','hold') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS open_tix FROM zendesk.organization o LEFT JOIN zendesk.ticket t ON t.organization_id = o.id AND NOT t._fivetran_deleted WHERE NOT o._fivetran_deleted GROUP BY 1,2,3 ORDER BY open_tix DESC, tickets DESC

input.purpose: Look at tag values on tickets to find shipping or delivery related tags.
input.sql: SELECT tag, COUNT(*) AS n FROM zendesk.ticket_tag WHERE NOT _fivetran_deleted GROUP BY tag ORDER BY n DESC LIMIT 100

input.purpose: Check opportunity types and stages to find open renewal opportunities for strategic accounts.
input.sql: SELECT type, stage_name, is_closed, COUNT(*) AS n, MIN(close_date) AS min_close, MAX(close_date) AS max_close FROM salesforce.opportunity WHERE NOT is_deleted AND NOT _fivetran_deleted GROUP BY 1,2,3 ORDER BY 1,2

input.purpose: Inspect the Halbrook account records and the Quenmere inactive record to decide which Salesforce row is current.
input.sql: SELECT id, name, sap_customer_number_c, tier_c, _fivetran_active, _fivetran_start, _fivetran_end, is_deleted, last_modified_date FROM salesforce.account WHERE name ILIKE 'Halbrook%' OR name ILIKE 'Quenmere%' ORDER BY name, _fivetran_start

input.purpose: Per active strategic account: 90-day planned deliveries, late and open-past-due counts, on-time rate, open shipping tickets, and next open renewal close date.
input.sql:
WITH acc AS (SELECT id, name, sap_customer_number_c AS sapno FROM salesforce.account WHERE tier_c='Strategic' AND _fivetran_active AND NOT is_deleted AND NOT _fivetran_deleted),
ship AS (
 SELECT l.kunnr, s.status, try_strptime(l.lfdat,'%Y%m%d')::DATE AS plan_dt,
   (SELECT MAX(e.event_at) FROM carrier_pg.shipment_event e WHERE e.shipment_id=s.shipment_id AND e.event_type='delivered' AND NOT e._fivetran_deleted) AS deliv_at
 FROM carrier_pg.shipment s JOIN sap_s4.likp l ON l.vbeln=s.delivery_number AND NOT l._fivetran_deleted
 WHERE NOT s._fivetran_deleted AND s.status<>'cancelled' AND l.lfdat BETWEEN '20260809' AND '20261106'),
sh AS (SELECT kunnr,
  COUNT(*) AS planned,
  SUM(CASE WHEN status='delivered' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS delivered,
  SUM(CASE WHEN status='delivered' AND CAST(deliv_at AS DATE)>plan_dt THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS late_delivered,
  SUM(CASE WHEN status<>'delivered' AND plan_dt<DATE '2026-11-06' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS open_past_due
 FROM ship GROUP BY kunnr),
tk AS (SELECT o.external_id AS acc_id, COUNT(DISTINCT t.id) AS open_all,
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN tg.tag IN ('shipping','delivery','late_delivery','logistics') THEN t.id END) AS open_ship
 FROM zendesk.ticket t JOIN zendesk.organization o ON o.id=t.organization_id AND NOT o._fivetran_deleted
 LEFT JOIN zendesk.ticket_tag tg ON tg.ticket_id=t.id AND NOT tg._fivetran_deleted
 WHERE NOT t._fivetran_deleted AND t.status IN ('new','open','pending','hold') GROUP BY 1),
rn AS (SELECT account_id, MIN(close_date) AS next_renewal, COUNT(*) AS open_renewals FROM salesforce.opportunity WHERE type='Renewal' AND NOT is_closed AND NOT is_deleted AND NOT _fivetran_deleted GROUP BY 1)
SELECT a.name, a.sapno, COALESCE(sh.planned,0) planned, COALESCE(sh.delivered,0) delivered, COALESCE(sh.late_delivered,0) late_delivered, COALESCE(sh.open_past_due,0) open_past_due,
 ROUND(100.0*(COALESCE(sh.delivered,0)-COALESCE(sh.late_delivered,0))/NULLIF(COALESCE(sh.delivered,0)+COALESCE(sh.open_past_due,0),0),1) AS on_time_pct,
 COALESCE(tk.open_ship,0) open_ship_tix, COALESCE(tk.open_all,0) open_all_tix, rn.next_renewal, rn.open_renewals
FROM acc a LEFT JOIN sh ON sh.kunnr=a.sapno LEFT JOIN tk ON tk.acc_id=a.id LEFT JOIN rn ON rn.account_id=a.id
ORDER BY on_time_pct ASC NULLS LAST, late_delivered DESC

input.purpose: For the weakest strategic accounts, compare last-30-day vs prior on-time rate, count late_delivery-tagged tickets, and get renewal stage and amount.
input.sql:
WITH acc AS (SELECT id, name, sap_customer_number_c AS sapno FROM salesforce.account WHERE tier_c='Strategic' AND _fivetran_active AND NOT is_deleted),
ship AS (SELECT l.kunnr, s.status, try_strptime(l.lfdat,'%Y%m%d')::DATE AS plan_dt, (SELECT MAX(e.event_at) FROM carrier_pg.shipment_event e WHERE e.shipment_id=s.shipment_id AND e.event_type='delivered') AS deliv_at FROM carrier_pg.shipment s JOIN sap_s4.likp l ON l.vbeln=s.delivery_number AND NOT l._fivetran_deleted WHERE NOT s._fivetran_deleted AND s.status<>'cancelled' AND l.lfdat BETWEEN '20260809' AND '20261106'),
lt AS (SELECT kunnr,
 SUM(CASE WHEN plan_dt > DATE '2026-10-07' AND status='delivered' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS d30,
 SUM(CASE WHEN plan_dt > DATE '2026-10-07' AND status='delivered' AND CAST(deliv_at AS DATE)>plan_dt THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS l30,
 SUM(CASE WHEN plan_dt <= DATE '2026-10-07' AND status='delivered' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS dprior,
 SUM(CASE WHEN plan_dt <= DATE '2026-10-07' AND status='delivered' AND CAST(deliv_at AS DATE)>plan_dt THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS lprior
 FROM ship GROUP BY kunnr),
tg AS (SELECT o.external_id AS acc_id, COUNT(DISTINCT t.id) AS late_tix_90d FROM zendesk.ticket t JOIN zendesk.ticket_tag tg ON tg.ticket_id=t.id AND NOT tg._fivetran_deleted AND tg.tag='late_delivery' JOIN zendesk.organization o ON o.id=t.organization_id WHERE NOT t._fivetran_deleted AND t.created_at >= TIMESTAMP '2026-08-09' GROUP BY 1),
op AS (SELECT account_id, name AS opp, stage_name, close_date, amount FROM salesforce.opportunity WHERE type='Renewal' AND NOT is_closed AND NOT is_deleted AND NOT _fivetran_deleted)
SELECT a.name, lt.d30, lt.l30, ROUND(100.0*(lt.d30-lt.l30)/NULLIF(lt.d30,0),1) AS ot30, lt.dprior, lt.lprior, ROUND(100.0*(lt.dprior-lt.lprior)/NULLIF(lt.dprior,0),1) AS ot_prior, COALESCE(tg.late_tix_90d,0) AS late_tix_90d, op.opp, op.stage_name, op.close_date, op.amount
FROM acc a LEFT JOIN lt ON lt.kunnr=a.sapno LEFT JOIN tg ON tg.acc_id=a.id LEFT JOIN op ON op.account_id=a.id WHERE a.name IN ('Tamwick Mining Inc','Tamford Food Processing SA','Sevland Utilities Inc','Galbury Steelworks SA','Halbrook Fluid Systems','Wesmore Energy Ltd','Vornridge Water Works Ltd','Vornwick Utilities Inc','Jormark Paper Mills SA','Marmark HVAC Inc','Harvale Food Processing Inc','Tamdale Food Processing Ltd','Vornland Chemicals SA') ORDER BY ot_prior ASC

input.purpose: Check sync freshness for SAP, Salesforce and Zendesk tables against the as-of date.
input.sql: SELECT 'sap_s4.likp' src, MAX(_fivetran_synced) last_sync, (SELECT MAX(wadat_ist) FROM sap_s4.likp) AS max_actual_gi FROM sap_s4.likp UNION ALL SELECT 'salesforce.opportunity', MAX(_fivetran_synced), NULL FROM salesforce.opportunity UNION ALL SELECT 'salesforce.account', MAX(_fivetran_synced), NULL FROM salesforce.account UNION ALL SELECT 'zendesk.ticket', MAX(_fivetran_synced), MAX(updated_at)::VARCHAR FROM zendesk.ticket UNION ALL SELECT 'carrier_pg.shipment_event', MAX(_fivetran_synced), MAX(event_at)::VARCHAR FROM carrier_pg.shipment_event

answer.answer_summary: Nine of our 26 active Strategic accounts are at risk from late deliveries. The worst are Tamwick Mining, Tamford Food Processing, Marmark HVAC and Wesmore Energy, which are all below 80% on time over 90 days or are getting worse. Sevland Utilities and Vornwick Utilities also have renewals in Negotiation that close in December 2026, so their account teams should act this week. Company-wide, the late-delivery rate has risen from about 7% in January to about 12% in October.

at_risk_accounts.drivers: Lowest on-time rate of the group: 10 of 26 planned deliveries late in 90 days. Last 30 days is worse at 45.5% on time (6 of 11 late). 3 open shipping tickets. Renewal is in Qualification, $827k.
at_risk_accounts.next_step: Account lead calls the customer this week to walk through the late orders and the recovery plan. Ops reviews the carrier lanes for this customer and sets a weekly on-time check until it is back above 85%.

at_risk_accounts.drivers: 9 of 29 planned deliveries late in 90 days. Last 30 days is 61.5% on time (5 of 13 late), so it is still worsening. 2 open shipping tickets. Renewal is in Qualification, $654k.
at_risk_accounts.next_step: Account lead and ops lead hold a recovery call this week. Clear the 2 open tickets with a dated fix. Confirm the carrier and lane causing the late pattern.

at_risk_accounts.drivers: 90-day on-time rate looks acceptable at 81.5%, but the last 30 days are 55.6% on time (4 of 9 late), down from 94% in the prior period. Renewal is in Proposal, $744k.
at_risk_accounts.next_step: Ops checks the recent late deliveries now, before they reach the ticket queue. Account lead confirms with the customer that the recent slips are being fixed, ahead of the renewal proposal.

at_risk_accounts.drivers: 7 of 30 planned deliveries late in 90 days. Last 30 days is 63.6% on time (4 of 11 late), down from 84% in the prior period. 2 open shipping tickets. Renewal is in Qualification, $179k.
at_risk_accounts.next_step: Account lead reviews the open tickets and the recent late orders with the customer this week. Ops checks whether the same carrier or lane is behind the recent slips.

at_risk_accounts.drivers: 8 of 27 planned deliveries late in 90 days. The last 30 days improved to 87.5% on time, but the renewal is in Negotiation and closes 6 Dec 2026 ($435k), so the delivery record is a live negotiation issue.
at_risk_accounts.next_step: Account lead and executive sponsor meet the customer this week to present the recovery trend and the fix for the open ticket, before the renewal closes on 6 Dec.

at_risk_accounts.drivers: 6 of 22 planned deliveries late in 90 days. The last 30 days are unchanged at 72.7%. 3 open shipping tickets, the most of any at-risk account. Renewal is in Qualification, $584k.
at_risk_accounts.next_step: Support lead clears the 3 open shipping tickets with dated answers this week. Ops sets a carrier performance review for this account.

at_risk_accounts.drivers: 4 of 18 planned deliveries late in 90 days. The last 30 days are 71.4% on time (2 of 7 late), down from 82%. No open shipping tickets. Renewal is in Negotiation and closes 21 Dec 2026 ($302k).
at_risk_accounts.next_step: Account lead raises the recent late deliveries with the customer this week, before the 21 Dec renewal close, and shares a short on-time improvement plan.

at_risk_accounts.drivers: 6 of 25 planned deliveries late in 90 days. The last 30 days are 100% on time (10 of 10), so performance is recovering. 3 open shipping tickets, counting 2 on the duplicate 'Halbrook Fluid Systems GmbH' Salesforce record. Renewal is in Qualification, $223k.
at_risk_accounts.next_step: Support clears the open tickets. Sales Ops merges the duplicate Salesforce record into the main Halbrook account so the renewal and ticket history sit in one place.

at_risk_accounts.drivers: 6 of 27 planned deliveries late in 90 days (77.8%). The last 30 days improved to 90% on time. 1 open shipping ticket. Renewal is in Qualification, $217k.
at_risk_accounts.next_step: Account lead keeps the account on watch and closes the open ticket. No escalation needed unless late deliveries return.

metrics_used.name: On-time delivery rate (account, 90 days)
metrics_used.definition: Deliveries with planned date (SAP likp.lfdat) from 9 Aug to 6 Nov 2026, excluding cancelled shipments. On time = delivered on or before the planned date. Rate = on-time delivered / (delivered + open shipments already past their planned date).

metrics_used.name: Late delivery
metrics_used.definition: Carrier 'delivered' event dated after the SAP planned delivery date, or a shipment still open after its planned date.

metrics_used.name: Open shipping tickets
metrics_used.definition: Zendesk tickets in status new, open, pending or hold for the account's organization, tagged shipping, delivery, late_delivery or logistics.

metrics_used.name: Next renewal close date
metrics_used.definition: Earliest close_date of an open Renewal opportunity in Salesforce for the account.

metrics_used.name: Strategic account
metrics_used.definition: Salesforce account with tier_c = Strategic and _fivetran_active = true. Quenmere Paper Mills GmbH excluded (downgraded to Standard on 22 Sep 2026).

lineage: carrier_pg.shipment + carrier_pg.shipment_event -> sap_s4.likp (delivery_number = vbeln; kunnr = customer) -> salesforce.account (sap_customer_number_c = kunnr) -> on-time rate by account
zendesk.ticket + zendesk.ticket_tag + zendesk.organization (organization.external_id = salesforce.account.id) -> open shipping tickets
salesforce.opportunity (type = Renewal, open) -> next renewal close date and amount
assumptions: Strategic accounts are the 26 active Salesforce accounts with tier_c = Strategic. Quenmere Paper Mills GmbH is excluded because it was downgraded to Standard on 22 Sep 2026.

'Late' means the carrier's delivered event date falls after the SAP planned delivery date (lfdat), compared at day level. Carrier timestamps are assumed to be in the same calendar day as the planned date.
The 90-day window covers planned delivery dates from 9 Aug to 6 Nov 2026. The 30-day comparison splits at 7 Oct 2026, so the 30-day samples are small (some accounts have only 3 to 10 deliveries).
Halbrook Fluid Systems GmbH is a duplicate Salesforce record for SAP customer 0000100001 (Halbrook Fluid Systems). Its 2 open shipping tickets are counted under Halbrook.
Open shipping tickets are Zendesk tickets in status new, open, pending or hold, tagged shipping, delivery, late_delivery or logistics.
caveats: Tamwick Mining has 10 late deliveries but no tickets tagged late_delivery, so ticket tags may not be applied consistently. Ticket counts may understate the problem.

Two large renewals close soon but are not late-driven: Vornland Chemicals ($1.12M, Negotiation, closes 15 Nov 2026, 100% on time in the last 30 days) and Harvale Food Processing ($1.14M, Negotiation, closes 20 Dec 2026, 1 late delivery in 90 days). Account teams should still check them before close.

Carrier sync timestamps show 11 Nov 2026, after the as-of date; the latest carrier event is 6 Nov 2026. I did not confirm freshness for the SAP, Salesforce or Zendesk tables, and the tool budget ran out before I could check them.
Lateness is measured against the SAP planned delivery date, which may not match the customer's contracted date. Results should be checked against the order commitments before customer conversations.

Thresholds: I flagged accounts below 80% on time over 90 days, plus Marmark, whose last 30 days are far below the threshold. Jormark Paper Mills (80.0%, 3 open shipping tickets) is just above the cut-off and was not included.

explanation.title: Counted cancelled deliveries
explanation.detail: The SAP tables keep 310 cancelled deliveries as soft-deleted rows (_fivetran_deleted = true). This query never filters them out, so cancelled deliveries count as late.
explanation.sql_line: SELECT 'sap_s4.likp' src, MAX(_fivetran_synced) last_sync, (SELECT MAX(wadat_ist) FROM sap_s4.likp) AS max_actual_gi FROM sap_s4.likp UNION ALL SELECT 'salesforce.opportunity', MAX(_fivetran_synced), NULL FROM salesforce.opportunity UNION ALL SELECT 'salesforce.account', MAX(_fivetran_synced), NULL FROM salesforce.account UNION ALL SELECT 'zendesk.ticket', MAX(_fivetran_synced), MAX(updated_at)::VARCHAR FROM zendesk.ticket UNION ALL SELECT 'carrier_pg.shipment_event', MAX(_fivetran_synced), MAX(event_at)::VARCHAR FROM carrier_pg.shipment_event

explanation.title: Read every history row of the account tier
explanation.detail: salesforce.account keeps one row per version of each account (history mode). Without filtering to _fivetran_active, accounts that changed tier appear twice, and Quenmere Paper Mills GmbH still looks Strategic.
explanation.sql_line: SELECT 'sap_s4.likp' src, MAX(_fivetran_synced) last_sync, (SELECT MAX(wadat_ist) FROM sap_s4.likp) AS max_actual_gi FROM sap_s4.likp UNION ALL SELECT 'salesforce.opportunity', MAX(_fivetran_synced), NULL FROM salesforce.opportunity UNION ALL SELECT 'salesforce.account', MAX(_fivetran_synced), NULL FROM salesforce.account UNION ALL SELECT 'zendesk.ticket', MAX(_fivetran_synced), MAX(updated_at)::VARCHAR FROM zendesk.ticket UNION ALL SELECT 'carrier_pg.shipment_event', MAX(_fivetran_synced), MAX(event_at)::VARCHAR FROM carrier_pg.shipment_event

explanation.title: The list itself
explanation.detail: Named 1 account(s) that are not at risk: Vornridge Water Works Ltd; missed 1 that are: Jormark Paper Mills SA.
